title: mmo-csharp shared appsettings schema
description: Documented surface for the per-server appsettings.json files. Each server (Login, Char, Map, Web) references this shared schema via $schema; server-specific shapes layer on top.

ConnectionStrings.description: Named connection strings read by EF Core (`AddGameDatabase`). The map / char / login / web servers all share the `GameDatabase` entry.

GameDatabase.description: MariaDB connection string for the shared game database. Format: `Server=...;Port=3306;Database=...;Uid=...;Pwd=...;CharSet=utf8mb4;`.

Server.description: Per-server runtime knobs. The fields below are common across Login/Char/Map; server-specific extras (StartPoint, IpBan, etc.) extend on top.

Port.description: Client-facing TCP port. Login=6900, Char=6121, Map=5191.

GrpcPort.description: gRPC server-to-server port. Login=6001, Char=6002, Map=6003.

TargetFPS.description: Game loop tick frequency. Login/Char=20, Map=60.

HeartbeatTimeout.description: ms — drop the client connection if no heartbeat (CZ_HEARTBEAT/CH_KEEP_ALIVE) arrives in this window.

MaxConnections.description: Cap on concurrent client TCP sockets.

OtherServerEndpoints.description: Map of peer-server gRPC URLs. Key name is matched case-insensitively to detect ServerType: Login* → Login, Char* → Char, Map* → Map.

ServerId.description: Numeric id used by Char-Server to disambiguate multiple map servers.

Scripting.description: TypeScript + Jint script engine settings (Map.Server only).

ScriptsRoot.description: Filesystem path to the compiled `dist/` directory produced by `tsc`.

HotReload.description: Re-load scripts on disk change without restarting the server. Dev-only.

AllowedHosts.description: ASP.NET Core allowed-host filter. Use `*` for any.
